questions.q_en:
In the question given below, some statements are given followed by some conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from the commonly known facts. Read the conclusions and decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements disregarding the commonly known facts.

Statements:

Some Ice is Snow.

Only Snow is Water.

Conclusions:

I. No Water is Ice.

II. Some Water is Ice.

III. All Ice is Water is a possibility.
options_en: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
questions.solution_en:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

I. No Water is Ice: Here, there is no relation between Ice and Water. Also, Water can never relate to Ice. So, conclusion I is true.

II. Some Water is Ice: Water can never relate to Ice. So, conclusion II is false.

III. All Ice is Water is a possibility: Water can never relate to Ice. So, conclusion III is false.

questions.q_en: In a certain code language, 'SET' is coded as '37' and 'MIX' is coded as '35'. How will 'WAR' be coded in that language?
questions.solution_en:
A (1)B(2)C(3)D(4)E(5)F(6)G(7)H(8)I(9)J(10)K(11)L(12)M(13)
Z(26)Y(25)X(24)W(23)V(22)U(21)T(20)S(19)R(18)Q(17)P(16)O(15)N(14)

SET:- opposite letter corresponding to S,E,T is H,V,G respectively.

So sum of H+V+G=8+22+7=37

Similarly for "MIX" , opposite letters are N,R,C respectively.

So sum = 14+18+3=35

Hence for WAR, opposite letters are D,Z,I respectively, so sum is 4+26+9=39.

questions.q_en:
A question and two statements numbered I and II are given below. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.

Six people - John, Mohan, Rohan, Geeta, Seeta and Meena are sitting around a circular table and all are facing the centre. What is the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan?

Statement I: Mohan stands second to the right of Geeta. Only one person stands between Mohan and Meena. Rohan is an immediate neighbor of Geeta.

Statement II: Only two people are sitting between Geeta and Seeta. Seeta is an immediate neighbor of both Meena and Mohan. Seeta is sitting immediate right of Mohan. Rohan is not an immediate neighbor of Meena.
options_en: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both the statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data either in statement I or statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
questions.solution_en:
Using Statement I alone:

Mohan stands second to the right of Geeta. Only one person stands between Mohan and Meena. Rohan is an immediate neighbor of Geeta. So, there are two cases possible i.e. Case 1 and Case 2.

So, the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan is not known.

Using Statement II alone:

Only two people are sitting between Geeta and Seeta. Seeta is an immediate neighbor of both Meena and Mohan. Seeta is sitting immediate right of Mohan. Rohan is not an immediate neighbor of Meena.

So, the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan is known i.e. Geeta sits immediate left of Rohan.

Only statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.

questions.q_en:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation correct?

250 - 100 + 25 ÷ 15 X 5 = 321
questions.solution_en:
We have the original equation as:-

250 - 100 + 25 ÷ 15 X 5 = 321

On checking each option one by one, after interchanging we get:-

Option (a): ÷ and +

250 - 100 ÷ 25 + 15 X 5 = 321

250 - 4 + 75

325 - 4

321 = 321

LHS is equal to RHS.

Thus, option (a) is correct.

Option (b): X and -

250 х 100 + 25 ÷ 15 - 5 = 321

25000 + 25/15 - 5

24996.67 ≠ 321

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (b) is incorrect

Option (c): ÷ and -

250 ÷ 100 + 25 - 15 X 5 = 321

2.5 + 25 - 15 X 5

2.5 + 25 - 75

27.5 - 75

-47.5 ≠ 75

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (c) is incorrect

Option (d): + and -

250 + 100 - 25 ÷ 15 X 5 = 321

250 + 100 - 8.33

350 - 8.33

341.67 ≠ 321

LHS is not equal to RHS.

Thus, option (d) is incorrect
